nodes.summary: A permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ is a king permutation if adjacent entries never differ by exactly $1$: for every position $i$ with $i + 1 < n$, neither $\sigma(i + 1) = \sigma(i) + 1$ nor $\sigma(i) = \sigma(i + 1) + 1$. Equivalently, $|\sigma(i + 1) - \sigma(i)| > 1$ for all adjacent positions $i$ and $i + 1$.

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 2$, every permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ in which adjacent entries never differ by exactly $1$, that is, $|\sigma(i + 1) - \sigma(i)| \ne 1$ whenever $i + 1 < n$, contains each of the classical patterns $12$, $21$, $132$, $213$, $231$ and $312$.
nodes.title: King permutations of length at least $2$ contain $12$, $21$, $132$, $213$, $231$ and $312$

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 2$, every permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ in which adjacent entries never differ by exactly $1$, that is, $|\sigma(i + 1) - \sigma(i)| \ne 1$ whenever $i + 1 < n$, contains the classical pattern $2413$ or the classical pattern $3142$. Since the separable permutations are those avoiding both $2413$ and $3142$, no such permutation is separable.
nodes.title: No king permutation of length at least $2$ is separable

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ written in one-line notation, $\operatorname{asc}(\sigma)$ is the number of positions $i$ with $i + 1 < n$ and $\sigma(i) < \sigma(i + 1)$.
nodes.title: Number of ascents of a permutation

nodes.summary: For a permutation $\sigma$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n - 1\}$ written in one-line notation, $\operatorname{des}(\sigma)$ is the number of positions $i$ with $i + 1 < n$ and $\sigma(i + 1) < \sigma(i)$.
nodes.title: Number of descents of a permutation

nodes.summary: The identity permutation of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, written $012$ in one-line notation and $123$ after shifting every value up by one, has two ascents, no descents, three left-to-right maxima, one right-to-left maximum, one left-to-right minimum and three right-to-left minima.
nodes.title: Statistics of the permutation $123$

nodes.summary: The reversal permutation $i \mapsto 2 - i$ of $\{0, 1, 2\}$, written $210$ in one-line notation and $321$ after shifting every value up by one, has no ascents, two descents, one left-to-right maximum, three right-to-left maxima, three left-to-right minima and one right-to-left minimum.
nodes.title: Statistics of the permutation $321$
Combinatorics

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
